checks.explanation: D-selection is not present in the disclosures array, so the placement requirement does not apply to this list.
No item with a basic services fee is priced on this list, so the includesText adequacy check is not triggered.
The list does not show a second mandatory fee for facilities, staff or overhead beyond the basic services component built into the other charges.
D-embalming is not present in the disclosures, so the adjacency check for the embalming disclosure does not apply.
The list contains no text stating that embalming is required for direct cremation, immediate burial, or closed-casket services.
The alternative-container disclosure and the direct cremation price range both appear on page 1, which counts as immediate conjunction under the same-page rule.
The direct cremation options include a choice with a container provided by the purchaser, and no text says a casket is required for cremation.
The direct cremation includesText states the charge includes cremation, and no separate cash advance line for a crematory fee is listed to create ambiguity.
Forwarding remains is one of the four items the FTC tip sheet treats as expected, and no line item for forwarding remains appears on the list.
The list contains only receiving, direct cremation, immediate burial and other merchandise; no optional package combining multiple goods and services at a single price is offered.
No text on the list asserts that a purchase is required by law, a cemetery or a crematory.
The list contains no claims about delaying decomposition or protecting a body from gravesite substances.
No other wording contradicts or undercuts the disclosed alternative-container statement, and the disclosure is presented on page 1 with the related prices.
